title: Hack Exposes Uber, Notion, and Cursor Data — and the Incident Happened in October! 🚨
body: Hack Exposes Uber, Notion, and Cursor Data — and the Incident Happened in October! 🚨

On 18 November, a security breach was revealed at "Fireworks AI", a company that rents out computing power to AI firms, with effects reaching its major clients. The incident itself happened on 23 October at a third-party cloud provider hosting the company's hardware.

The attacker exploited a vulnerability at that cloud provider and stole data including model weights — the "brain" of a trained AI model — along with billing information without payment card numbers, and datasets.

The result: Uber is notifying about 150,000 drivers that their data was stolen, Cursor confirmed that the attackers used stolen data to publish a malicious extension in its code editor's store, and Notion was affected in about 1% of workspaces.
Do you trust that your data is safe with the companies you use? 🔐
